To access assistance regarding Kisan Call Centre Toll Free Helpline 1800-180-1551, dial the official 24x7 toll-free emergency/support helpline or visit india.gov.in. Citizens can also schedule doorstep service visits or locate their nearest Common Service Center (CSC) to apply for government services with complete guidance and nominal prescribed fees. Source: india.gov.in

Step by Step Application Process

  • Visit the official portal https://india.gov.in.
  • Authenticate using your registered Mobile Number and OTP.
  • Fill in required personal, identity, and bank account details accurately.
  • Upload scanned supporting documents and complete eKYC verification.
  • Pay the prescribed fees via online payment gateway and download the acknowledgment receipt.

List of Required Documents

  • Aadhaar Card (with linked mobile number)
  • Voter ID / Residence Proof / Ration Card
  • Income Certificate & Active Bank Account Details
  • Passport size photograph

Helpline & Support

For official support, access the help desk on https://india.gov.in or call the toll-free citizen helpline. Source: https://india.gov.in
